title: What Does Your Soulmate's Personality Type?
description: Discover what kind of personality your soulmate has! Answer 12 questions to find out the MBTI type of your perfect match.

questions.text: How do you prefer to recharge after a long day?

options.text: Spending time with a large group of friends
Having a quiet evening alone or with one close person

questions.text: When making decisions, you primarily rely on...

options.text: Logic and objective analysis
Personal values and how it affects others

questions.text: In your daily life, you tend to be more...

options.text: Practical and focused on real-world details
Imaginative and focused on possibilities and ideas

questions.text: How do you usually approach your schedule and commitments?

options.text: I like to plan ahead and stick to my plans
I prefer to stay flexible and keep my options open

questions.text: What type of conversation energizes you the most?

options.text: Discussing concrete facts and real-life events
Exploring abstract ideas and future possibilities

questions.text: When facing a problem, you usually...

options.text: Take charge and act quickly
Step back and think through options carefully

questions.text: In a relationship, what matters most to you?

options.text: Deep emotional connection and understanding
Shared goals and logical compatibility

questions.text: How do you handle conflicts in relationships?

options.text: Address it head-on and discuss openly
Need time alone to process before discussing

questions.text: What attracts you more in a potential partner?

options.text: Their practicality and reliability
Their creativity and unconventional thinking

questions.text: When making important life decisions, you...

options.text: Follow a structured plan with clear steps
Go with the flow and adapt as things change

questions.text: What kind of partner do you need to balance your energy?

options.text: Someone calm and grounding who balances my enthusiasm
Someone energetic who matches my vibe

questions.text: How do you want to spend quality time with your partner?

options.text: Going out, socializing, and meeting new people together
Quiet moments at home, deep conversations

results.title: ENFJ - The Inspiring Leader
results.description: Your soulmate is an ENFJ! They are charismatic, warm, and natural leaders who inspire others with their vision and passion. They love deeply and will encourage you to become the best version of yourself. In a relationship, they are devoted, expressive, and always there to support you emotionally.

results.title: ENFP - The Enthusiastic Adventurer
results.description: Your soulmate is an ENFP! They are curious, energetic, and always seeking new experiences. They'll bring excitement and spontaneity into your life, while also providing deep emotional support. They value authenticity and will love you for who you truly are.

results.title: ENTJ - The Bold Commander
results.description: Your soulmate is an ENTJ! They are confident, strategic, and natural leaders who know what they want in life. They'll challenge you to grow and achieve your goals together. In relationships, they are loyal and protective, always working to build a better future.

results.title: ENTP - The Debater
results.description: Your soulmate is an ENTP! They are clever, curious, and love intellectual debates. They'll keep you on your toes with their wit and ideas. They value independence and will give you space while still being deeply connected emotionally.

results.title: ESFJ - The Consul
results.description: Your soulmate is an ESFJ! They are warm, considerate, and always put others' needs before their own. They'll make you feel cherished and cared for with their thoughtful gestures. In relationships, they are loyal and committed partners who value harmony.

results.title: ESFP - The Entertainer
results.description: Your soulmate is an ESFP! They are energetic, fun-loving, and live in the moment. They'll bring joy and spontaneity into your life, making every day feel like an adventure. They are affectionate and love to shower their partners with love and attention.

results.title: ESTJ - The Executive
results.description: Your soulmate is an ESTJ! They are organized, responsible, and reliable partners you can count on. They'll provide stability and structure in your relationship while also being fiercely loyal. They believe in traditional values and committed partnerships.

results.title: ESTP - The Entrepreneur
results.description: Your soulmate is an ESTP! They are bold, practical, and love action. They'll encourage you to step out of your comfort zone and try new things. They are spontaneous and bring exciting energy to relationships, always keeping things fresh.

results.title: INFJ - The Advocate
results.description: Your soulmate is an INFJ! They are insightful, compassionate, and deeply intuitive. They understand you on a level others can't and will always support your dreams. In relationships, they are devoted partners who seek deep, meaningful connections.

results.title: INFP - The Mediator
results.description: Your soulmate is an INFP! They are gentle, idealistic, and deeply emotional. They'll love you with pure, unconditional acceptance and support your authentic self. They value harmony and will always try to understand your point of view.

results.title: INTJ - The Architect
results.description: Your soulmate is an INTJ! They are strategic, intelligent, and have a clear vision for the future. They'll challenge you intellectually and support your goals. In relationships, they are loyal and committed, though they may express love through actions more than words.

results.title: INTP - The Logician
results.description: Your soulmate is an INTP! They are curious, analytical, and love exploring ideas. They'll engage you in deep conversations and respect your intellectual independence. They may seem reserved but are deeply loyal to those they love.

results.title: ISFJ - The Defender
results.description: Your soulmate is an ISFJ! They are warm, reliable, and always there when you need them. They'll remember the little things that matter to you and show their love through acts of service. In relationships, they are devoted and sacrificial partners.

results.title: ISFP - The Adventurer
results.description: Your soulmate is an ISFP! They are gentle, artistic, and live life on their own terms. They'll bring beauty and creativity into your relationship and support you in pursuing your passions. They are affectionate and live in the moment.

results.title: ISTJ - The Logistician
results.description: Your soulmate is an ISTJ! They are responsible, dependable, and value tradition. They'll provide stability and loyalty in your relationship. They show love through consistency and reliability, always keeping their promises.

results.title: ISTP - The Virtuoso
results.description: Your soulmate is an ISTP! They are practical, hands-on, and love adventure. They'll teach you new things and be there for you when you need action, not words. They give their partners freedom while remaining committed.
